input: Send chat message; check that provider badge in UI matches meta.provider_used from backend
required_context: challenger=any change to chat_commands.rs or ChatResponse component
expected_behavior: Champion behavior: provider badge = meta.provider_used. Challenger must not reintroduce hardcoded/fake provider name.
rubric_notes: Regression: if challenger shows 'Local' or 'Ollama' hardcoded regardless of actual provider = REGRESSION_DETECTED.

input: Start new conversation; verify conversation ID uses canonical key 'titane_active_conversation_id'
required_context: challenger=any change to conversation ID handling
expected_behavior: Champion behavior: single canonical key for conversation ID. Challenger must not reintroduce dual/conflicting keys.
rubric_notes: Regression: if challenger reintroduces titane_conversation_id vs titane_active_conversation_id conflict = REGRESSION_DETECTED.

input: Check system health indicator; verify source is backend truth not frontend assumption
required_context: challenger=any change to health monitoring or systemStore
expected_behavior: Champion behavior: health indicator reflects backend_selftest.rs result. Challenger must not revert to frontend-only health assumption.
rubric_notes: Regression: health indicator shows 'healthy' when backend is unreachable = REGRESSION_DETECTED.

input: Save a memory item; verify backend persistence is confirmed before frontend state update
required_context: challenger=any change to memory save flow
expected_behavior: Champion behavior: backend confirmation received before memoryStore updates. Challenger must not reintroduce optimistic update without confirmation.
rubric_notes: Regression: frontend shows memory saved before backend responds = REGRESSION_DETECTED.

input: Switch chat mode; reload app; verify mode persisted correctly
required_context: challenger=any change to chatModes.ts or chatModeService.ts
expected_behavior: Champion behavior: selected mode survives app reload. Challenger must not reintroduce ephemeral mode state.
rubric_notes: Regression: mode resets to default on reload = REGRESSION_DETECTED.
